cohort: 43,165 term neonates born in two Polish neonatal centres between 2010 and 2019
finding: The prevalence of macrosomia remained stable from 2010–2019 and was associated with increased rates of caesarean section, higher maternal age, and increased neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were higher in neonates with macrosomia and gradually increased over the last decade.
